description: Author .kiro/specs/02-solitaire-collection/tasks.md in the exact style of Spec 1's tasks.md: a phased '- [ ] **N.M Title.**' checklist, each task citing requirement IDs and ending green on `make build test lint`, with '⛳ CHECKPOINT' review-gate tasks between phases (including checkpoints where the user plays each game before continuing), a placeholder-art register if relevant, and a traceability note. Order the work so the shared solver is built EARLY, because Klondike's upgrade and every game's winnable-deal pool depend on it.
steps: Read the completed FEAT-001 requirements.md and FEAT-002 design.md and Spec 1's tasks.md first. Open with the same preamble Spec 1 uses: tasks are small and incremental; EVERY task ends with `make build test lint` passing (Swift 6 strict concurrency, zero warnings) and cites the requirement IDs it satisfies; CHECKPOINT tasks are review gates where implementation pauses for the user to run the app and approve. Keep the 🎨 placeholder-art legend if any placeholder assets (e.g. game-tile art for the four new games) are produced.

Phase 1 — Shared solver + package placement (BUILD THE SOLVER FIRST). Tasks: create the SolverKit package (or add solver module to AIKit per the design decision) wired into the enforced dependency direction and update Docs/Architecture.md's module map/mermaid if a new package (R-SOLVER, R-NFR-SOLVER, plus the Architecture.md doc-upkeep requirement); implement the three-valued solver (winnable/unwinnable/unknown) with the state encoding, transposition table, pruning, and budget from design.md, for Klondike + FreeCell + Spider(1&2 suit) + Pyramid + TriPeaks; solver correctness tests cross-checking exhaustive search on small brute-forceable deals (R-QA2 solver-correctness); if the design drafted an ADR (0003+), reference finalizing it here. End each task on `make build test lint`.

Phase 1 checkpoint — ⛳ CHECKPOINT: solver classifies the known fixtures correctly (including FreeCell MS deal #11982 = unsolvable) and passes correctness cross-checks; make build test lint green. Review before Phase 2.

Phase 2 — FreeCell (first consumer of the solver; exercises MS numbering). Tasks: FreeCell GameDefinition (deal 8 columns 7/7/7/7/6/6/6/6, 4 free cells, 4 foundations; build-down alt-color, foundations up-by-suit), supermove capacity option (formula + empty-destination halving) on by default, Safe autoplay reusing Klondike Spec 1 'Safe' definition on by default; Microsoft deal-numbering mode (LCG per design.md) + our-own 1..1,000,000 seeds; author Docs/Rules/freecell.md (original writing; mark NEEDS REVIEW items); scenario tests incl. supermove BOUNDARY values and MS conformance for deals #1, a mid-range deal, and #11982; FreeCell table layout + catalog registration following the Architecture.md 9-step checklist. Cite R-FREECELL-*, R-QA2-*, R-SOLVER-*. End on make build test lint.
Phase 2 checkpoint — ⛳ CHECKPOINT: user PLAYS a FreeCell deal end-to-end (drag and keyboard), MS deal reproduction verified. Review before Phase 3.

Phase 3 — Spider. Tasks: Spider GameDefinition using DeckDefinition 'spider-104' (1/2/4 suits, default 2; 10-column deal 6x4 + 5x6; stock deals 10 at a time; same-suit-run move-as-unit vs mixed-suit single-card moves; K..A same-suit auto-collect; no-deal-onto-empty-column default with option; scoring 500/-1/+100 and timer-only option); author Docs/Rules/spider.md; scenario tests per rule/option/variant. Cite R-SPIDER-*, R-QA2-*. End on make build test lint.
Phase 3 checkpoint — ⛳ CHECKPOINT: user PLAYS a Spider deal (at least 1- and 2-suit) end-to-end via drag and keyboard. Review before Phase 4.

Phase 4 — Pyramid. Tasks: Pyramid GameDefinition (28-card pyramid rows 1..7 + 24 stock/waste; King removes alone; pairs summing to 13; exposure rule; redeals 0/1/2/unlimited default 2; scoring formula documented); author Docs/Rules/pyramid.md (mark exact scoring formula NEEDS REVIEW); scenario tests. Cite R-PYR-*, R-QA2-*. End on make build test lint.
Phase 4 checkpoint — ⛳ CHECKPOINT: user PLAYS a Pyramid deal end-to-end via drag and keyboard. Review before Phase 5.

Phase 5 — TriPeaks. Tasks: TriPeaks GameDefinition (three overlapping peaks rows 3/6/9/10 = 28 + 24 stock, 1 up as current + 23 to draw; play one rank above/below current regardless of suit; K-A wrap on by default with option to disable; draw resets streak; streak bonus scoring; longest-streak stat); author Docs/Rules/tri-peaks.md; scenario tests. Cite R-TRIP-*, R-QA2-*. End on make build test lint.
Phase 5 checkpoint — ⛳ CHECKPOINT: user PLAYS a TriPeaks deal end-to-end via drag and keyboard. Review before Phase 6.

Phase 6 — Winnable-deal pools + Daily Deal + Klondike retrofit. Tasks: Scripts/ winnable-deal generator producing >= 10,000 solver-confirmed winnable deals per game and per Spider suit-count variant, checked in or build-time cached, with the versioned pool artifact from design.md, wired to a Makefile/Scripts step (R-WINNABLE); 'Winnable deals only' setup option for all five games drawing from the pool (R-WINNABLE); Daily Deal per game deriving a deterministic deal from the pool via the local-date seed (R-DAILY); retrofit Klondike with solver-backed hints alongside the Spec 1 heuristic hints and add 'Winnable deals only' + 'Daily Deal' to Klondike setup (R-KLON2); extend statistics to all five solitaires incl. per-game Daily Deal streak (R-STATS2). Cite the IDs; end each on make build test lint.

Phase 6 checkpoint — ⛳ CHECKPOINT: user verifies Winnable-deals-only and Daily Deal are deterministic for a fixed date/seed across all five games, and Klondike shows solver-backed hints. Review before Phase 7.

Phase 7 — Quality gates, tutorials/help, docs finalize. Tasks: interactive tutorials + hints/coach + in-app rules reference for each of the four new games and the Klondike solver-hint coach (product.md DoD, ux learning/help); sim invariants wired at 500 (make test) / 10,000 (make test-long) per game/variant (R-QA2); full UI test suite (win each game via drag AND keyboard-only; deterministic Winnable-only + Daily Deal given fixed date/seed) (R-QA2); coverage >= 90% for EngineCore and each new rules target; finalize Docs/Architecture.md (incl. any dependency-diagram update) and all Docs/Rules/*.md; confirm any ADR (0003+) matches implementation; resolve or re-affirm the Open Questions Q2-* before their dependent tasks are marked complete. End on make build test lint (and make test-long for the final gate).
Phase 7 final checkpoint — ⛳ CHECKPOINT (final): user runs make test-long; all quality gates and accessibility/keyboard checks pass across all five solitaire games.

Add a 'Placeholder-art register' section (if any 🎨 game-tile art for the four new games is produced) and a 'Traceability note' stating every task lists the requirement IDs it implements, every requirement in requirements.md is covered by at least one task, and the Q2-* open questions must be resolved before their dependent tasks complete — mirroring Spec 1's tasks.md tail.

Self-check: solver is Phase 1 (earliest); a play-the-game CHECKPOINT exists after each of FreeCell, Spider, Pyramid, TriPeaks and after the winnable/daily/Klondike-retrofit phase; every task cites requirement IDs and ends with the make build test lint gate.
acceptance_criteria: .kiro/specs/02-solitaire-collection/tasks.md exists, uses the phased '- [ ] **N.M Title.**' checklist format, and matches Spec 1's tasks.md style (preamble about the make build test lint exit criterion, ⛳ CHECKPOINT gates, placeholder-art register if relevant, traceability note).
The shared solver is built in the FIRST implementation phase, before the games' winnable pools and the Klondike retrofit that depend on it.
A 'user plays the game' ⛳ CHECKPOINT exists after each new game (FreeCell, Spider, Pyramid, TriPeaks) and after the winnable/daily/Klondike-retrofit work.
Every task cites the requirement IDs it satisfies and every task ends green on `make build test lint` (final gate also runs make test-long).
A traceability note confirms every requirement is covered by at least one task and that Q2-* open questions must be resolved before dependent tasks complete.
verification: Read tasks.md end to end; confirm phased checklist, per-task requirement-ID citations, the make build test lint exit criterion phrasing, and ⛳ CHECKPOINT tasks including per-game play gates.
Confirm Phase 1 is the solver and that FreeCell/Spider/Pyramid/TriPeaks and the winnable-pool/Daily-Deal/Klondike-retrofit tasks come after it.
Cross-check that every R-* area from requirements.md (R-SPIDER, R-FREECELL, R-PYR, R-TRIP, R-SOLVER, R-WINNABLE, R-DAILY, R-KLON2, R-STATS2, R-QA2, R-NFR-SOLVER) is referenced by at least one task.
findings: Authored .kiro/specs/02-solitaire-collection/tasks.md mirroring Spec 1's tasks.md style exactly: same preamble (every task ends with `make build test lint` passing, Swift 6 strict concurrency, zero warnings; tasks cite requirement IDs; CHECKPOINT tasks are review gates), the 🎨 placeholder-art legend, `- [ ] **N.M Title.**` task form, `- [ ] **⛳ CHECKPOINT N.**` gates, a Placeholder-art register, and a Traceability note at the tail. Phase 1 builds SolverKit first (package creation + dependency wiring + Docs/Architecture.md §1.2 edit + ADR 0003 finalize + solver + correctness cross-checks + #11982 unsolvable fixture), since Klondike's retrofit and every winnable pool depend on it. Play-the-game checkpoints follow FreeCell (CP2), Spider (CP3), Pyramid (CP4), TriPeaks (CP5), the winnable/Daily/Klondike-retrofit phase (CP6), and a final make test-long gate (CP7). Phase order matches the environmental_context suggested order: (1) SolverKit, (2) FreeCell, (3) Spider, (4) Pyramid, (5) TriPeaks, (6) winnable pools + Daily Deal + Klondike retrofit + statistics, (7) tutorials/help + quality gates + docs finalize. Every Spec-2 requirement area is referenced by >=1 task (R-SETUP2, R-SPIDER, R-FREECELL, R-PYR, R-TRIP, R-SOLVER, R-WINNABLE, R-DAILY, R-KLON2, R-STATS2, R-QA2, R-NFR-SOLVER) and each Open Question Q2-1..Q2-14 is mapped to the task that resolves it. The Architecture.md edit and ADR 0003 finalize are scheduled as an explicit Phase 1 task (1.2), per design.md which deliberately did not edit Architecture.md. No builds run (documentation deliverable; no Swift source exists yet).
